ai.title: Set nextquotareset on upgrade and add createdat column
ai.summary: Database schema updated with `created_at` timestamp column and `next_quota_reset` logic fixed to align with Stripe billing periods. Migration `0005_minor_the_professor` adds the `created_at` column to the `user` table. Webhook handlers and auth options now explicitly set `next_quota_reset` based on `current_period_end` or `next_payment_attempt` instead of defaulting or omitting it. Refactor in `handleSubscriptionChange` simplifies credit calculation and ensures quota reset is triggered on subscription changes.

eli5.text: Users now get a clear signup date and a quota reset date that lines up with their Stripe billing cycle. Previously, your quota reset date could land on today's date instead of the end of your billing period, which meant your usage limits might not refresh when expected. Now, when someone signs up or upgrades, their reset date is set to match when their Stripe subscription actually renews. The system also records exactly when each account was created. These changes only affect the account and billing records, they don't change your plan prices, usage limits, or the features you see.

ai.title: Referral redemption clears quotaexceeded flag
ai.summary: Successful referral code redemption now resets `quota_exceeded` to false alongside credit addition. This ensures users blocked by quota limits regain access immediately upon earning referral bonuses. Changes affect `web/src/app/api/referrals/helpers.ts` and `route.ts`. Commented-out SQL aggregations removed from referral query logic.

eli5.text: When you successfully use a referral code, the system now immediately restores your access if you had previously been blocked for exceeding your usage limit, in addition to adding your bonus credits. This affects anyone who redeemed a referral code and had hit their quota limit, you would notice that your service access resumes right away instead of staying locked. The change also removed some leftover, unused code from the referral tracking system, and is already live.

ai.title: drizzle-orm bumped 0.33 to 0.36
ai.summary: drizzle-orm updated 0.33.0 to 0.36.0, drizzle-kit to 0.27.0. Propagated across backend, common, web package.json. Syncs ORM versions across monorepo.

eli5.text: The internal tools the app uses to store and read its data were updated to a newer version across all of its main components. If you are an end user, you will not notice anything different now or in future; this change simply makes the app easier to maintain and keeps everything consistent. It is a behind-the-scenes maintenance update rather than a new feature.
